intro: Namibia has about 3 million people, one of the lowest population densities in the world.

chapters.title: People
text: The Ovambo are the largest group; others include the Herero, Kavango, Nama, Damara, San and people of European descent. English is official, and Oshiwambo, Afrikaans and German are also spoken.

chapters.title: Windhoek
text: Windhoek, the capital, has German colonial buildings.
